findings.source_quote: “healthy and, even more importantly, Biblical emotional choices”
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha sehemu hiyo iwe: “kujifunza kufanya maamuzi yenye afya ya kihisia na, muhimu zaidi, yanayopatana na Biblia.”
findings.translation_quote: “kuchagua hisia kwa njia yenye afya na, muhimu zaidi, inayotegemea Biblia”

findings.source_quote: “Two are more general for everyone and two are specifically given for us ladies.”
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “zinawahusu wote” kwa “ni za jumla zaidi na zinawahusu kila mtu,” ili kuhifadhi maana ya kwamba aina mbili hizo ni za jumla kwa kila mtu.
findings.translation_quote: “Mbili ni za jumla zaidi na zinawahusu wote”

findings.location: Heading and discussion of “A Sober Spirit”
findings.source_quote: “A Sober Spirit”; “to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Roho Yenye Utulivu” kama kichwa na, katika ufafanuzi, “kuwa mtulivu na mwenye kujizuia rohoni; kuwa na kiasi na kutotawaliwa na hisia.” Hivi vinatofautisha kiasi na utulivu wa roho unaosisitizwa na kifungu.
findings.translation_quote: “Roho Yenye Kiasi”; “kuwa mtulivu na mwenye kujizuia rohoni; kuwa na kiasi na kutotawaliwa na hisia.”

findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha mwisho wa sentensi uwe “akitenda tu kwa mapenzi Yake.”

findings.source_quote: “It is an attitude of sitting back and letting God lead—whether exciting or boring”
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “kukaa kimya” kwa “kutulia na kumwacha Mungu akuongoze” ili kuhifadhi wazo la kutokujitahidi kudhibiti mambo, si kukaa kimya tu.
findings.translation_quote: “Ni mtazamo wa kukaa kimya na kumwacha Mungu akuongoze”
